question: Does the joint-intervention action space help under equal total cost on the bounded-degree connected motif SCM?
primary_contrast: paired coverage_pair minus coverage_single over the 20 fresh systems
primary_gate: mean coverage_pair / mean coverage_single < 0.90 and upper endpoint of two-sided 95% paired t interval for the absolute difference < 0
within_pair_contrast: paired coverage_pair minus random_pair over the same systems; claim coverage selection advantage only if the upper endpoint of its two-sided 95% paired t interval < 0
interpretation: A primary pass supports joint-action capability for this particular synthetic graph family, not a foundation-model or posterior-risk advantage. A within-pair failure narrows the result to the action space. Report every cell and exact costs, including failures.
limits: Same simulator family as development; no external-domain generalization. Both pair and single policies pay per sample plus per actuated node, so sample counts differ at matched total cost.
forbidden: No change to action menu, graph rule, learner, masks, budget, or metric after seeing these seeds; no closed-source model API
